Title: Rohan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rohan - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Kavita - 41 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line
4. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Rohan stands in the park. Kavita stands near him.]

Kavita: "What lovely weather!"

[Rohan goes jogging in the park.]

Kavita (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rohan swings on the swing.]

Rohan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rohan does yoga on a mat.]

Rohan: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Rohan: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan walks across the courtyard.]

Rohan: "And then?"

[Rohan runs to Mother.]

Kavita: "Show me too!"

[Rohan hides behind the tree.]

Rohan: "What happened?"

[Rohan searches for his lost ball.]

Rohan: "And then?"

[Rohan peeks out from behind the door.]

Rohan: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 3: The terrace - Day

[Rohan stands on the terrace. Kavita stands near him.]

Rohan: "What a nice place."

[Rohan flies a kite on the terrace.]

Kavita (surprised): "One more time!"

Scene 4: The snowy hillside - Day

[Rohan stands in the snow. Kavita stands near him.]

Rohan: "Let's begin."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Rohan: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Rohan builds a snowman.]

Rohan (laughing): "Show me too!"

[Rohan catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Rohan: "Yes, of course."

[Rohan slides down the snowy slope.]

Rohan (happily): "I really enjoyed today."
